plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Fortinet FortiWeb WAF appliances (PEN 12356, tree 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.107). Besides standard IF-MIB 64-bit interface traffic, it collects CPU utilization (fwSysCpuUsage, 0-100%), memory utilization (fwSysMemUsage, 0-100%) and total memory (fwSysMemCapacity, MB converted to bytes).
name: Firewall

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the FortiWeb appliance (fwSysCpuUsage, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.107.2.1.5.0), stored as 0-100 percent. Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the FortiWeb appliance (fwSysMemUsage, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.107.2.1.7.0), stored as 0-100 percent. Values outside 0-100 are dropped.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total physical RAM of the FortiWeb appliance (fwSysMemCapacity, OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.107.2.1.8.0). The collector converts MB to bytes (MB * 1024 * 1024). Values 0 and 4294967295 are dropped.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).
